title: Concept: Dependency audit narrowed to direct packages
description: nuget.config declares an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies.
